name: Raptor Boyfriend: A High School Romance
source:
Raptor Boyfriend: A High School Romance is a dating sim about a teen girl who moves to a small secret community of cryptids. Romance a magical Fairy, a sensitive Sasquatch and a bold Velociraptor. A satirical 90's teen drama about trying to find love in your last year of high school.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Raptor Boyfriend: A High School Romance》是一款恋爱模拟游戏，讲述一名少女，搬入一个隐秘的小型神秘生物社区后的故事。与魔法妖精、敏感的野人，以及大胆的迅猛龙，展开恋情。这是一出带有讽刺意味的20世纪90年代青春剧，讲述在高中最后一年，努力寻找爱情的故事。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273080/]Steam[/url]]
